ops.en: vigorous, healthy, energetic, and strong
ops.cn: 健壮有活力的；精力旺盛的

ops.en: strong, robust, or full-bodied in sound, appetite, feeling, or expression
ops.cn: 强劲有力的；饱满的；热烈的
ops.usage_note: Sexual/lustful associations are context-dependent and should not organize the learner Core.

ops.en: growing or existing in rich, dense, and abundant profusion, especially vegetation, hair, or foliage
ops.cn: 茂盛的；浓密繁茂的；生长旺盛的

ops.en: richly elaborate, abundant, or profuse in detail
ops.cn: 丰富繁复的；细节繁茂的

ops.value: luxuriant = abundant/profuse growth or detail; luxurious = characterized by luxury, comfort, or expensive quality.

ops.en: to speak about someone in a harmful, unfair, or false way; to defame
ops.cn: 诽谤；恶意中伤；说有害或不实的话

ops.en: harmful, evil, or malevolent in nature or influence
ops.cn: 有害的；恶毒的；恶性的

ops.value: malign can be a verb meaning defame or an adjective meaning harmful/evil; malignant is a separate adjective, especially common in medicine for cancerous disease.

ops.en: required by law, rule, authority, or official policy; not optional
ops.cn: 强制的；法定的；必须的

ops.en: a skillful or carefully controlled movement or change of position
ops.cn: 机动动作；巧妙而受控的移动或调整

ops.en: a strategic action or move intended to achieve an advantage or goal
ops.cn: 策略性行动；为取得优势或目标采取的手段

ops.en: to move, position, or guide someone or something skillfully or carefully
ops.cn: 巧妙移动、操纵或定位

ops.en: to act or manipulate circumstances strategically in order to achieve an aim
ops.cn: 运用策略谋划、操纵以达到目的

ops.value: maneuver@o7134 and manoeuvre@o2949 are existing separate stable owners for regional spellings. Preserve exact-spelling lookup ownership; o2949 is read-only in this package and must not be merged or stolen.

ops.en: to badly damage, crush, tear, or deform something, or to badly distort words, information, or meaning
ops.cn: 严重损坏、压碎、撕裂；也指把语言、信息或意思弄得面目全非

ops.en: informal: a person who is wildly enthusiastic, obsessive, or uncontrolled about something
ops.cn: （非正式）狂热者；痴迷者；行为极端的人

ops.value: Historical mental-health use of maniac as a clinical label is dated and can be offensive; avoid it as neutral clinical terminology.

ops.en: many and varied; having many different forms, features, or kinds
ops.cn: 多种多样的；多方面的；具有多种形式的

ops.en: a short statement expressing a general truth, rule, or principle for conduct
ops.cn: 格言；箴言；表达一般真理或行为准则的短句

ops.value: Lowercase maxim is the common noun. Capitalized Maxim as a personal name belongs to case-sensitive reference truth, not lowercase learner Core.

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same adjective.

ops.en: small, scanty, or deficient in amount, quality, extent, or nourishment
ops.cn: 贫乏的；微薄的；不足的

ops.en: to follow a winding course or wander indirectly in movement, speech, thought, or writing
ops.cn: 蜿蜒前行；漫无目的地绕行；说话或思路迂回

ops.note: Noun: a winding bend or curve, especially in a river.

ops.en: pleasantly soft, rich, smooth, gentle, or mature in sound, flavor, color, mood, or character
ops.cn: 柔和醇厚的；成熟温和的；圆润的

ops.en: to become calmer, gentler, more relaxed, or more mature
ops.cn: 变得平和、温柔、放松或成熟

ops.en: to become or make something softer, smoother, riper, or more mature
ops.cn: 变柔和、成熟或醇化；使之如此

ops.en: low-status, routine, and often tedious, especially of work or tasks
ops.cn: 低级而单调的；琐碎枯燥的（工作）

ops.note: Noun 'a menial' for a domestic servant is dated and can sound demeaning.

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to fascinate or hold someone's attention completely
ops.cn: 使着迷；完全吸引注意力

ops.en: to induce hypnosis in someone
ops.cn: 对某人施催眠

ops.en: formal: to distribute, administer, or impose something, especially punishment or justice
ops.cn: （正式）给予、施加；尤指惩罚或正义

ops.meaning_cn: 给予、施加某物，尤指惩罚/正义

ops.note: Rare noun: a boundary or boundary line.

ops.en: to imitate someone's speech, actions, appearance, or manner, sometimes for humor or satire
ops.cn: 模仿某人的言语、动作、外表或举止

ops.en: a person who imitates others, especially as a performer
ops.cn: 模仿者；模仿表演者

ops.en: imitative; resembling or produced as an imitation
ops.cn: 模仿的；仿制的

ops.en: to chop or cut food into very small pieces
ops.cn: 把食物切碎、剁碎

ops.en: food, especially meat, chopped into very small pieces
ops.cn: 碎肉；切碎的食物

ops.meaning_cn: 直言不讳；毫不婉转地说

ops.en: to soften or moderate one's words or expression, usually in the negative phrase not mince words
ops.cn: 把话说得委婉；常用于 not mince words 表示直言不讳

ops.note: To walk in an affectedly dainty manner.

ops.en: consisting of various different kinds of items that do not fit into one single category
ops.cn: 各种各样混合在一起的；杂项的

ops.en: covering or containing a variety of different subjects, aspects, or kinds
ops.cn: 包含多种不同方面或种类的

ops.en: rare/literary: to cause or suggest doubt, fear, or apprehension
ops.cn: （罕见/文学）使疑虑；使不安；预感不妙

ops.meaning_cn: 我心里感到不安；我有不祥预感

ops.en: rare/literary: to cause or suggest doubt or apprehension; the related noun misgiving(s) is commoner
ops.cn: （罕见/文学）使疑虑或不安；更常见相关名词为 misgiving(s)

ops.value: Common related noun: misgiving(s) = doubt, uneasiness, or apprehension.

ops.en: to give a false, inaccurate, or misleading account of someone or something
ops.cn: 歪曲；误传；作虚假或误导性陈述

ops.meaning_cn: 把某事物歪曲/误称为另一事物
虚假陈述自己的身份、资格或情况

ops.en: to sexually assault, abuse, or subject someone to unwanted sexual touching or advances
ops.cn: 性侵；性骚扰；对某人实施不受欢迎的性接触或侵犯
ops.usage_note: Serious sexual-abuse term. Historical broader 'harass/annoy' use is dated and should not organize modern learner Core.

ops.en: to calm, soothe, or appease someone's anger, anxiety, or hostility
ops.cn: 安抚；平息怒气、焦虑或敌意

ops.value: Literal physical 'soften' is rare/technical relative to the dominant appease/calm sense.

ops.en: a system or state headed by a monarch; the monarch's powers may be absolute or constitutionally limited
ops.cn: 君主制；由君主担任国家元首的制度，可为绝对君主制或君主立宪制

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to obtain or keep exclusive control, possession, or use of something
ops.cn: 垄断；独占；完全控制

ops.en: to dominate a market, resource, conversation, person's time, or attention so others have little access
ops.cn: 垄断市场/资源；独占谈话、某人的时间或注意力

ops.en: showing an unhealthy or excessive interest in death, disease, or disturbing subjects; medically, relating to disease or pathology
ops.cn: 病态地关注死亡、疾病或阴暗事物的；（医学）疾病/病理相关的

ops.en: near death; figuratively in terminal decline, inactive, or no longer growing
ops.cn: 垂死的；（比喻）衰败停滞、濒临消亡的

ops.en: derogatory/offensive: an insulting term for a person regarded as very stupid
ops.cn: （贬义/冒犯）蠢货；侮辱性地指被认为很愚蠢的人
ops.usage_note: Do not use as neutral clinical terminology; historical IQ-classification use is obsolete.

ops.value: Capitalized/accented Morón is a geographic proper name and belongs to case-sensitive reference truth, not lowercase moron learner Core.

ops.en: a short phrase or sentence expressing the beliefs, aims, values, or guiding principle of a person, group, school, organization, or institution
ops.cn: 座右铭；格言；表达个人或组织信念、目标或原则的短句

ops.en: a raised heap, pile, or rounded mass of earth or other material, natural or artificial
ops.cn: 土堆；隆起；堆状物，可天然或人工形成

ops.en: to form or pile something into a rounded heap or raised mass
ops.cn: 堆成隆起的一堆；使成土丘状
